    cap wPolicy v=153/256-(3/8:ℝ)*v 2 ∧
      (TypedEligible wPolicy v ↔ (1/2:ℝ)<cap wPolicy v ∧
        (∀ j : Fin 4, fullSquare j v<cap wPolicy v) ∧
        (1+v 0)/2<cap wPolicy v ∧ v 0<(25/128:ℝ)) :=
headers.after_complete_header:

    cap wPolicy v=153/256-(3/8:ℝ)*v 2 ∧
      (TypedEligible wPolicy v ↔ (1/2:ℝ)<cap wPolicy v ∧
        (∀ j : Fin 4, fullSquare j v<cap wPolicy v) ∧
        (1+v 0)/2<cap wPolicy v ∧ v 0<(25/128:ℝ)) :=

definitions.name: Policy
definitions.raw_region: abbrev Policy := Fin 16

definitions.name: sourceId
definitions.raw_region: def sourceId (p : Policy) : ℕ := p.val+1

definitions.name: Selected
definitions.raw_region: def Selected (p : Policy) (i : Fin 4) : Prop := p.val<15 ∧ (sourceId p).testBit i.val=true

definitions.name: selectedMass
definitions.raw_region:
def selectedMass (p : Policy) (v : LogFour) : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 4, if Selected p i then v i else 0

/-- Literal unselected-prefix square from e+previous, with previous
counting ONLY earlier unselected coordinates. -/

definitions.name: selectedSquare
definitions.header: def selectedSquare (p : Policy) (j : Fin 4) (v : LogFour) : ℝ :=
definitions.raw_region:
def selectedSquare (p : Policy) (j : Fin 4) (v : LogFour) : ℝ :=
  selectedMass p v + (∑ i : Fin 4, if i.val<j.val ∧ ¬Selected p i then v i else 0)+2*v j

definitions.name: fullSquare
definitions.raw_region:
def fullSquare (j : Fin 4) (v : LogFour) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : Fin 4, if i.val<j.val then v i else 0)+2*v j

/-- The original W cap is 153/256-3*z/8. Its x<25/128 and
(1+x)/2 gates below must not be confused with another selected mask. -/

definitions.name: cap
TypedEligible
typedResidual
selectedLinear
definitions.raw_region:
def selectedLinear (p : Policy) : LogFour →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 4, if Selected p i then ContinuousLinearMap.proj i else 0

definitions.name: sumLinear
definitions.raw_region: def sumLinear : LogFour →L[ℝ] ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 4, ContinuousLinearMap.proj i

definitions.name: fullSquareLinear
selectedSquareLinear
definitions.header: def selectedSquareLinear (p : Policy) (j : Fin 4) : LogFour →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
definitions.raw_region:
def selectedSquareLinear (p : Policy) (j : Fin 4) : LogFour →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  selectedLinear p+(∑ i : Fin 4,
    if i.val<j.val ∧ ¬Selected p i then ContinuousLinearMap.proj i else 0)+
      (2:ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.proj j

definitions.name: capLinear
definitions.header: def capLinear (p : Policy) (left : Bool) : LogFour →L[ℝ] ℝ :=

definitions.name: capOffset
definitions.raw_region:
def capOffset (p : Policy) (left : Bool) : ℝ :=
  if p.val<15 then (if left then 1/2 else 57/64) else 153/256

definitions.name: affineCap
definitions.header: def affineCap (p : Policy) (left : Bool) (v : LogFour) : ℝ :=
definitions.raw_region: def affineCap (p : Policy) (left : Bool) (v : LogFour) : ℝ := capLinear p left v+capOffset p left

definitions.name: first
definitions.raw_region: def first : Policy := ⟨0,by norm_num⟩

definitions.name: wPolicy
definitions.raw_region: def wPolicy : Policy := ⟨15,by norm_num⟩

definitions.name: bank
definitions.raw_region: def bank : Finset ℕ := Finset.range 16

definitions.name: eligible
definitions.raw_region:
def eligible (j : ℕ) (v : LogFour) : Prop :=
  if hj : j<16 then TypedEligible ⟨j,hj⟩ v else False

definitions.name: residual
definitions.raw_region:
def residual (j : ℕ) (v : LogFour) : ℝ :=
  if hj : j<16 then typedResidual ⟨j,hj⟩ v else 0
